headline: Uniinfo Telecom Services files AGM minutes
hook: AGM concluded for Uniinfo Telecom Services
summary: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the exchange. The filing records the completion of standard shareholder proceedings. Retail investors holding the stock can review the formal proceedings as per regulatory requirements. This procedural filing has no direct impact on broader market indices.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate stock impact
